_about: In-universe chronology of Aeon's End reconstructed from the wiki lore texts. 'sources' are wiki page titles (validated against the DB). Release order != story order: the boxes jump between eras.

eras.name: The Dawn of Breach Magic
eras.when: Thousands of years before the descent into Gravehold
eras.summary: Before humanity, the troggs (three tribes: Yud, Orp and Zom) shaped the world and then went to sleep in the cave that would become Gravehold. Much later, magic users called witches existed, but breach magic as we know it was born when Kiri Maesan, a young scientist from Erythiza, lived among the phoenixes in the jungle and learned to mimic the way they rip breaches between aether particles. Corruption already existed: animals that turned were culled by the phoenixes as part of a natural cycle.

eras.name: The World That Was
eras.summary: A world of great sprawling cities: Erythiza (seat of the Royal Erythiza Academy and its university), Karek (a shining brass port city that held the First Tribe's great archive), Azrius, the harbor towns of M'hlark and Port Hanon with its City Guard. There were steam trains, inventors and scholars (Antoni Lexive, Kwananya Ja'ar, Kavoc, Auren). Corruption was a slow, inevitable fact of life: people who felt it rising would give up their names and descend to Gravehold, away from society — the origin of the word 'Nameless'. The world's true name, later recovered by Yan Magda, was Khasad Vol.

eras.name: The Great Calamity
eras.when: The fall of The World That Was
eras.summary: At the Royal Erythiza Academy, Dr. Soleil D'Arca studied The Hunger, a filter-feeder that metabolises corruption. When it fused with a boy it became the Oracle of Filth, strong enough to turn a healthy human into a Nameless in an instant. Erythiza vanished in a single day: an invisible eruption, a tsunami of corruption that turned citizens, plants, animals and even stones into monsters. The Blight Lord — the 'Blighted God' — eclipsed the moon over Karek and froze the kneeling First Tribe in green glass; the archivist Raven alone survived, hidden while giving birth to Xaxos. The sky became a starless abyss and the first Purge erased most of history.
tone: the end of the world already happened

eras.name: The Descent
eras.summary: Survivors roam the wasteland in clans led by the Sisterhood: elders and sisters who speak the sister-words, followed by the 'Followers' (men and anyone who cannot learn the words), who hunt, heal, forge and carry. Young Brama, a Sister Initiate, believes a defensible city must still exist and leads a ragtag band on a pilgrimage — Janti, Thraxir, Leisan, Mazahaedron, Raven and the child Xaxos, Adelheim, Dalana, Fawn, Myrna, Joanna. They pass the dead town of Donnyton (The Coven), the swamp of The Infecter and the Blighted God's crystal fields, and finally find Gravehold, an abandoned underground citadel guarded by The Wrath and its last mad keeper. The conclaves split: half wanted to stay on the surface; Brama, with Thraxir at her side, led the rest underground and counselled collapsing the cave mouth.

eras.name: Old Gravehold — The Long Siege
eras.summary: Gravehold lives in darkness: the dirt market, the hovels, Chasmwalk, the balustrade, the crypts, The Depths where the dead are thrown. Breach mages turn the Nameless' own breaches into weapons. Brama, high elder, guards tradition and faith; Malastar trains younglings through the Ordeal; Thraxir, breach commander, dies to Rageborne and the post is never filled again. Wave after wave of Nameless besiege the city (Carapace Queen, Crooked Mask, Prince of Gluttons, Horde-Crone, Blight Lord's return, Wayward One...). Then exiles emerge from the Void — Yan Magda, freed from the Black Mausoleum, with her 'Void-tossed orphans' Garu, Dezmodia, Kain and Remnant — and fight beside Gravehold against the Thrice-Dead Prophet, from whose corpse the Umbra Titan bursts. Mist enters the breach a fourth time and returns as a 'vessel'. Xaxos founds a masked blood-magic circle in the Cragbellows, while the Knight of Shackles (the corrupted Thraxir) leads the dead against the city.

eras.name: The Fall
eras.summary: Xaxos' experiment draws Maelstrom, a colossal orb of blades, through the largest breach ever seen. Gravehold burns. Dezmodia sacrifices herself, erupting in light and bringing the cavern down on Maelstrom. Survivors flee through the tunnels; Soren, Z'hana's husband, dies holding the line; Cairna is crushed and left behind; Ohat and Ulgimor survive alone in the ruins for decades. Xaxos flees into the Void. Mist finds that the surface, believed dead, is green and alive.

eras.name: New Gravehold
eras.summary: Humanity rebuilds on the surface: farms, outposts (Southpost, the Northern Outpost), walls twice as high. The Legacy generation of mages defeats Spawning Horror, Fungal Mesh, Haze Fiend, Deathmind, Maelstrom: Risen and finally Xaxos: Ascended. Brama exiles Xaxos' students; Arachnos rebels, is banished to the woods and experiments on Nameless (Maggoth, Fenrix, Ageless Walker, Experiment 153). New mages appear: Inco the plant-raised boy, Razra and her beast Rip, Mazra the prodigy, Talix of Southpost, Soskel, Rhia, Claudia, Gygar, Sahala, Qu. A traitor mage uses glyphs to drive Necroswarm against Southpost — it is Z'hana. Mages discover Azer, an older surface village of Tethered mages, and dive into sunken Old Gravehold. A redeemed Xaxos returns from the Void and leads an expedition to the Fountain of Souls, where Dezmodia and Arachnos are reborn and Thraxir regains his mind.

eras.name: The Civil War and the Second Fall
eras.when: About a generation after The Fall
eras.summary: Wild Void portals open everywhere. Brama's paranoia hardens — Yan Magda, Garu, Mist and the 'Void mages' are exiled — while Z'hana, allied with Azer, demands freedom to study the Void. The Bishop of Scrolls narrates it all as a fairy tale and gathers an army of Nameless in the Void. The war ends with Mist revealed as the architect of a 'Second Fall', a manufactured apocalypse meant to unite humanity against her and birth 'the World To Come'. The outcome branches: New Gravehold is forever changed.

eras.name: The Scattered Age
eras.when: Decades to centuries after New Gravehold
eras.summary: Dorian bends causality decades on. Hundreds of years later, humanity lives in small villages around old ruins: Souston, protected by head woman Camellia's glyph-carving; Faen in the eastern swamp, whose Tethers were once turned against each other; the line of Xaxos still bearing fangs and claws (Naftir); Lilly — by every clue the daughter of Razra and Inco — lost in the Void where it 'isn't sundown yet'. Further still rises Cindercrown, a city of iron walls ruled by the Regi, built over 'the System' — sealed tunnels where Nameless are buried — patrolled by Strike teams, the heirs of the old dagger captains. Through time-travel experiments (Nook's Anomaly), Cindercrown's era loops back into Old Gravehold's.

events.title: The troggs shape the world
events.summary: The three trogg tribes — Yud (life, creation), Orp (shadow, death) and Zom (dreamers) — shape the young world in harmony, build Gravehold as a sanctuary from the chaos, then sleep in the deep cave, forgotten.

events.title: Kiri Maesan learns from the phoenixes
events.summary: A scientist from Erythiza follows a phoenix flock in the jungle for months, befriends a juvenile phoenix and copies its dive to open the first human breach. She abandons the word 'witch' and calls herself a breach mage. Her pyroclasm is later preserved in Karek's archive.

events.title: The age of scholars and inventors
events.summary: Antoni Lexive describes aether's communication properties, Kwananya Ja'ar studies aether nanoparticles, Kavoc probes 'the empty white space beyond our breaches' and leaves a compendium of thousands of spells. Auren sketches flying craft and mechanical prosthetics, blueprints that will be found centuries later by Rhys.

events.title: Giving up one's name
events.summary: Corruption creeps through everyone: tendrils, scales, fangs. The dignified descend to Gravehold before losing their minds; Port Hanon's guard beat back those who wait too long. Port Hanon itself is built on a Nameless burial ground.

events.title: The Hunger and the Oracle of Filth
events.summary: Dr. Soleil D'Arca's specimen, The Hunger, fuses with a boy in the Academy laboratory and becomes the Oracle of Filth, amplifying corruption exponentially.

events.title: Erythiza is consumed
events.summary: The great city vanishes in a day. A wave of corruption spreads outward; a market becomes a slaughter. Unknown heroes contain the source somewhere — young Brama wonders where they put it.

events.title: The night of emeralds
events.summary: The Blight Lord, first Nameless to touch the world, turns Karek and the harbor towns of M'hlark to green glass. The First Tribe's elder kneels to it as a divine messenger; none are spared except the archivist Raven and her newborn, Xaxos.

events.title: Brama's pilgrimage
events.summary: Brama, a young sister, defies elders who call permanence hubris and leads her clan to look for a defensible city. Janti, a trans woman who earned the sister-words, and Thraxir, a Follower who opened a breach with his sword, are proof that the old rules are wrong.

events.title: Journey's End: finding Gravehold
events.summary: Under a red sun, The Wrath coils over the abandoned citadel. A lone corrupted keeper haunts its halls. Brama's people claim it; the cave mouth is collapsed to entomb them in safety.

events.title: The first sieges
events.summary: Nameless come through breaches into the cave itself. The Prince of Gluttons, fourth to besiege the city, devours its memories — even the name of the world. Breach mages learn to use the breaches as weapons.

events.title: Yan Magda returns
events.summary: Sentenced by The Conclave to eternal sleep in the Black Mausoleum, Yan Magda is pulled out by Garu, wanders the spiral of worlds gathering Void orphans (Dezmodia, Garu, Kain, Remnant) and emerges in the caves, where she finds the child Indira lost in her Ordeal. She chooses friendship over vengeance.

events.title: Death of Thraxir
events.summary: Breach commander Thraxir is split in two by Rageborne. He is thrown into The Depths with the other dead; no one is ever elected to his post.

events.title: The Thrice-Dead Prophet
events.summary: Killed three times, the Prophet crushes Frayla and breaks the South Wall; Sparrow beheads it, and the Umbra Titan bursts from its neck. The Titan's shadow touches the coward Ohat and creates Ulgimor, who drives the Titan into The Depths.

events.title: Mist becomes the vessel
events.summary: On her fourth trip into the breach, a crystalline 'sound' enters Mist and remakes her. Gex calls her 'the being we once called Mist'.

events.title: The masked circle of the Cragbellows
events.summary: Xaxos and like-minded mages meet in robes and masks in the ruins of the Cragbellows, practising blood magic and listening to whispers from the breach. The Hollow Crown's acolytes were mages who practised forbidden rituals in the same rubble.

events.title: Maelstrom
events.summary: Xaxos' experiment pulls Maelstrom through. Gravehold burns; Dezmodia erupts and buries it under the collapsing cavern. Xaxos vanishes into the Void ('I'm sorry...').

events.title: The surface is alive
events.summary: Tracking Bladius' minions upward, Mist finds forests, streams and sky. The survivors found a camp that becomes New Gravehold.

events.title: The Legacy campaign
events.summary: New mages defeat Spawning Horror (its pods become equipment), free Brama from Fungal Mesh, survive Haze Fiend, protect their memories from Deathmind, and bring down Maelstrom: Risen. Xaxos, 'having drunk from the well from which the Nameless draw power', is defeated — dragged into the Void or fleeing broken.

events.title: Arachnos' rebellion and exile
events.summary: Arachnos continues Xaxos' research, is condemned by the Council, leads a rebellion and is banished with his followers to the woods, where his rituals create monsters and eventually fuse him with a Void spider.

events.title: The New Age expedition
events.summary: Commander Soskel's northern expedition vanishes with rare artifacts. A rescue team meets Rhia, frees Soskel from Arachnos, saves Talix from the Ageless Walker, defeats Fenrix in a summer blizzard and finds Lost, an amnesiac mage bound in fiery armour, in a hidden bunker.

events.title: Into The Wild: the traitor mage
events.summary: Inco feels the plants die. Razra and Rip, seeking the cause, are captured by a cloaked woman using glyphs that lure Nameless and drain human aether. Necroswarm — Inco's childhood caretaker — is driven against Southpost. The traitor bears Xaxos' insignia and a veteran's ankle tattoo. The Council hides the truth.

events.title: The Wailing and The Wanderer
events.summary: Blue onyx spreads through the forest from a screaming flying Nameless. Brama and Mazra find in the archives that The Wanderer is related to the Wayward One.

events.title: Return to sunken Gravehold
events.summary: Gygar's water-breathing expedition finds the Fortress — a Nameless shelled in the rubble of their homes — the Burrower, Cairna living alone on legs of stone, and Ohat with Ulgimor.

events.title: The Burning Kor reaches Azer
events.summary: New Gravehold's farms and patrols push Portalborn south; a man of flame burns Azer's forests. Lucien, who lost his Tether, and Reth, who never had one, stand against it.

events.title: Invasion of the Void
events.summary: Xaxos, redeemed, returns to ask for help: the Fountain of Souls, a living pool in the Void, swallows the aether that crosses breaches. Mages fight inside the Void protecting Xaxos: Outcast; Dezmodia and Arachnos are reborn and Thraxir regains his mind.

events.title: The exiles
events.summary: Brama exiles Arachnos and Karak, forbids Mist from Voidwalking, exiles Garu for opening a Void portal and finally sentences Yan Magda to a cottage in the wilds. Indira watches and hates herself for it.

events.title: Brama against Z'hana
events.summary: Z'hana, unmasked as the traitor and allied with Azer, claims a city must be a haven for everyone, dangerous or not. Families and mentors pick sides: Malastar and Kadir with tradition, Taqren torn, Razra ready to forgive after one punch.

events.title: Mist Revealed
events.summary: Mist raises her arms to the Void: a Second Fall, to make humanity hate her as one and build 'the World To Come'.

events.title: Inco's pilgrimage
events.summary: After the war, Inco carries a sapling grown where Necroswarm fell into the Void and plants it in a blooming swamp grove, where strange glassy-eyed children play.

events.title: Villages around the ruins
events.summary: Souston, Faen and other villages live in peace thanks to glyph-carving; heroes like Bayli long for the legends of Old Gravehold. Xaxos' descendants still carry the Void in their bodies.

events.title: Cindercrown and the System
events.summary: Strike teams descend into the System beneath the iron city of Cindercrown, where the Terror in Brass swims through metal. Professor Stake goes looking for relics; Nook's time experiments threaten to snap time itself.
